source_set_format: sha256 two spaces relativepath newline; sorted by relativepath. Receipt and immutable revisions/ archives excluded.
scope: Original bounded T8103/T8020 16K page-table scalar construction, canonical decoding, complete caller-owned snapshot validation, software lookup and exact-RID/exclusive-stream policy checks. No IOMapper, IOVA allocator, ownership proof, DMA or initialized hardware.

profile.range_provenance: Inherited from the existing source/observed-ADT ownership plan; not new hardware observation. Explicit caller policy still required.

checks.initial_test_gap: First mutation run found high_root_entry was rejected incidentally by a populated leaf's aperture check. Fixture changed to an empty child at L1 index128; the final run now catches omission of the independent 32-bit root-index guard.
checks.reference_byte_checks: Four m1n1 files matched exact local Git objects at121fcbf; three Linux files matched acquisition SHA256, Git-blob hash and length. No source fetched or imported into a transport runtime.
checks.tests_not_claimed: No pinned SDK/kernel compile, ABI qualification, MMIO read, DART initialization, invalidation, DMA or runtime hardware result. Broad repository checks were not rerun for this isolated directory.

future_kernel_adapter_requirements: Verify actual instance/granule/address width/stream topology, power, locks, firmware ownership and handoff roots before any access. Other DART generations are unsupported.
Prove exclusive device/RID/SID/slot ownership and IOPCIFamily-to-ADT mapper binding. Do not assume mapper phandle is SID or infer shared BT/Wi-Fi ownership.
Wire retained table/data physical pages, complete DRAM/reservation/carveout policy and lifetime. Host buffer pointers are not device physical addresses.
Implement serialized atomic publication, coherency/cache maintenance and barriers, stream invalidation, bounded completion and faults. Timeout is failure and prohibits reuse.
Implement genuine IOMapper/IODMACommand/map/unmap/rollback and MSI paths. No bypass or successful placeholder.
Require requester quiescence and completed invalidation before retirement; quarantine on uncertainty. Existing mapped quarantine is untouched.
Review/build a real adapter and qualify it separately under root's authorized runtime/recovery control; host validation does not qualify GPU or Wi-Fi.
file_ownership: All newly written files and temporary compiler products confined to m1-dart; temporary products removed. No active host, packet, HID revision, checkout source, build recipe or registry changes.
